title: Retain experimentally supported MG1655 adenine induction of add
finding: The draft represents expression induction for xapA, umpH and deoD, but omits the measured adenine-induced add response in its declared MG1655 scope. Its description mentions only historical E. coli B induction as a nontransferable observation, overlooking independent K-12 MG1655 primary evidence already retained for the shared Add step in the preceding salvage-II record.

primary_source.result: Methods explicitly use K-12 MG1655 and derivatives, M9 with 2 g/L glucose, 37 C, mid-log phase, with or without 100 micrograms/mL adenine. Results sec9 explicitly report 17.61-fold induction of add transcript. Sec13 explicitly excludes add and deoD from direct PurR regulation.

proposed_fix: Add independently verified CHEBI:16708 adenine and Entrez:945851 add gene nodes and an adenine activates add gene-expression edge with this primary reference, exact locators, MG1655 culture scope and no direct binding/allostery/PurR claim. Retain the historical E. coli B scope limit separately. Reuse already retained issuing authority identities only after checking the actual original Gene record and chemical label.
acceptance: Exact added chemical/gene IDs resolve against issuing originals; gene maps to MG1655 b1623 and P22333.
Gene-level induction edge cites PMID21572102 Methods sec3 and Results sec9; sec13 non-PurR limit preserved.
No adenine activates Add protein or PurR directly represses add edge is introduced.
All 101 original graph edges and their scientific scope remain unchanged except explicit, reviewed textual clarification.
Both native and closed schemas, independent source replay and graph/KGX evidence preservation pass on the successor SHA.
basis: Direct independent inspection of the original article, not reliance on the previous curated record as authority. Full draft read and complete parsed node/edge inventory establish the target omission.
